messages:
Eva: Quick design review — updated roles matrix + invite drawer proto. Focused on two things: 1) show effective permissions on hover (no modal), 2) add inline SSO hint when org SSO is enforced. Proto: https://redwood.ai/proto/rbac-invite

Matt: Love the hover idea. Question: how do we show inheritance from parent org? Maybe a pill: 'Inherited from Team > Product' on hover?

Lia: +1. Also research flagged confusion around the label 'Seats' — users thought it meant licenses, not active people. Suggest 'Active seats' or 'Assigned seats'.

Sam: Accessibility nit: invite drawer currently traps focus but tabindex order is off — keyboard tests fail when you close the SSO dropdown. Repro: tab through fields, open SSO, press Esc, focus lands after the save button instead of the drawer close. Propose adding a skip link and making the close button first in tab order.

Eva: Good catch @Sam. I'll add a skip-link and move the close button into the first tabbable slot. Also thinking about micro-copy for the SSO hint — current copy: 'SSO enforced — users must authenticate with the org provider.' Is that too wordy?

Matt: Shorter option: 'SSO enforced. Invited users must sign in with your SSO.'

Lia: Microcopy suggestions (pick one):
- Primary: 'SSO enforced — invites require SSO sign-in.'
- Tooltip: 'Managed by your organization's SSO policy.'

DesignBot: Prototype update: v3 pushed to /proto/v3 (hover cards + inline SSO hint). Accessibility checklist updated: keyboard focus order, aria-live for invite status, visible focus ring preserved.

Sam: Small UX idea: add a keyboard shortcut to quickly jump to Audit > Activity (e.g., `g a`). Also propose a compact keyboard hint in the top-left quick-nav for power users.

Eva: Love the audit-jump. For audit log nav, proposing a sticky search bar and left/right arrow to step through individual events (quick-skip). Will post mockups in a follow-up message. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
